summary: Plan executive movements, assess travel risk and prepare protection records. Explore the five-day VIP protection course outline.
lede: VIP protection training helps close protection practitioners, personal assistants and security supervisors assess risks and coordinate executive movements. It covers threat and vulnerability assessment, travel-risk planning, advance and venue work, team coordination and incident decision records, with practical exercises to develop draft plans and handover documents.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate protection decisions, executive movements or the support functions around them. It suits practitioners with some operational exposure who need a clearer method for assessing risk, preparing plans and handing over decisions.
prerequisites: No prerequisite was supplied in the course information. The proposed intermediate outline is most useful if you have some exposure to security operations, executive support, travel coordination or protective services.
